claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 remains CONFIRMED on LOCAL (stratified r=0.058, CI upper 0.125, n844) and is SUPPORTED on distributed primary correlation (stratified r=-0.038, CI upper 0.029 <0.15, TOST p=2.0e-08, n844, delta=0.10 also passes p=3.0e-05) but is FALSIFIED per frozen C1-C7 gate on the tested distributed infrastructure: 2-node Flask HS256 symmetric JWT (shared TESTBED_SECRET) with independent per-node SQLite session DB, independent in-memory cache, round-robin routing, N=42/condition/endpoint (1008 per baseline, n_non304 844). Gate failure is C1 only: mean TN=0.667 <0.85 driven solely by /api/session/status TN=0.0 (valid-token deltas 3.0 vs 0.0 on local) due to session store non-replication; /api/user/profile and /api/data/list TN=1.0. No evidence for behavioral-structural correlation on any endpoint (|r|<0.074 all p>0.24). Parallel-channel architecture is NOT justified for multi-node deployment under stateless round-robin without session affinity or shared session store for session-dependent endpoints. Orthogonality correlation itself is not falsified; product may proceed with sticky affinity or externalized session store. No inference to real CDN hierarchies, non-Flask frameworks, or N>=50 concurrency warranted. Remains EXPERIMENTAL, not VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE.
